Secondary batteries · Commercial

Nickel-metal hydride · NiMH

Hydrogen in a metal hydride is oxidized while nickel oxide is reduced.

Animated operating principles

Ion and electron pathways

OH⁻ · electrolyte / membrane Electrons e⁻ · external circuit

Simplified reaction directions and pathways. Actual particle numbers and speeds differ.

Electrode and electrolyte principles

Aqueous KOH; OH⁻ mediates electrode reactions.

Overall discharge: MH + NiOOH → M + Ni(OH)₂

Advantages

Robust and cadmium-free.

Drawbacks & challenges

Lower energy density and greater self-discharge than lithium-ion.

Materials & supply constraints

Hydrogen-storage alloys commonly include rare earths such as lanthanum.

Main applications

Hybrid vehicles and rechargeable AA cells
